sprint_backlog.title: Refactor `extract_all` to use ThreadPoolExecutor
sprint_backlog.description: The current `MultiSourceCorrelator.extract_all()` method utilizes a synchronous, sequential loop for API extraction and DSPy analysis. This blocks network I/O and causes severe performance degradation for large time windows. We need to implement a concurrent architecture.
acceptance_criteria: Import and utilize `concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor` in the extraction loop.
Ensure worker threads are safely bound by the global `RateLimiter`.
Extraction and analysis tasks process in parallel without causing race conditions in the target dictionaries/lists.
Overall execution time for multi-day extractions is significantly reduced.

sprint_backlog.title: Remove Heuristic Dictionary Parsing in Insight Extraction
sprint_backlog.description: The `analyze_session_insights()` function relies on brittle `try/except` blocks and dictionary key-sniffing heuristics (e.g., checking for strings > 50 chars) to parse LLM outputs. It must be updated to trust the structured Pydantic payloads returned by the upgraded DSPy `SessionInsightModule`.
acceptance_criteria: Remove all heuristic string-length checking logic from `analyze_session_insights`.
Strictly cast and validate the `model_dump()` output from `SessionInsightModule` using Pydantic models.
Implement explicit error handling for validation failures rather than silent fallback mutations.

sprint_backlog.title: Implement Dual-Write Reconciliation Job
sprint_backlog.description: If ChromaDB embedding generation fails, `PersistenceManager` correctly marks the SQLite record status as 'failed' to prevent data loss. However, there is no mechanism to automatically retry these orphaned records on startup.
acceptance_criteria: Create a `reconcile_failed_vectors()` method in `PersistenceManager`.
Trigger this method automatically on application startup or via a dedicated CLI command.
The method should query SQLite for sessions with `indexing_status='failed'`, regenerate their chunks, and attempt to re-insert them into ChromaDB.
Update the SQLite status to 'completed' upon successful reconciliation.

sprint_backlog.title: Optimize Tiktoken Initialization
sprint_backlog.description: The `estimate_session_tokens()` method performs an inline import and initialization of the `tiktoken` encoding on every call, creating unnecessary overhead during high-volume operations.
acceptance_criteria: Move the `tiktoken` import to the module level.
Cache the `tiktoken.get_encoding('cl100k_base')` initialization so it is reused across function calls rather than instantiated per session.

sprint_backlog.title: Implement ChromaDB Batch Upserts
sprint_backlog.description: Vector chunks are currently added to ChromaDB sequentially or isolated by session. Transitioning to batch upserts will vastly improve ingestion throughput.
acceptance_criteria: Refactor `VectorStore.add_chunks()` to accept multi-session lists of documents and metadata.
Batch the inserts before calling `self.collection.add()`.
Implement batch size limits to respect maximum payload thresholds for ChromaDB.

sprint_backlog.title: Migrate Ollama Embedding to Async HTTPX
sprint_backlog.description: The `OllamaEmbeddingFunction` uses a synchronous `httpx.Client`. Shifting to an asynchronous client will prevent thread locking when processing batch embeddings.
acceptance_criteria: Replace `httpx.Client` with `httpx.AsyncClient` inside `OllamaEmbeddingFunction`.
Update the calling methods to gracefully handle the asynchronous embedding requests.

sprint_backlog.title: Implement Dependency Injection for LLM Providers
sprint_backlog.description: To facilitate robust unit and integration testing without relying on live API calls or local Ollama instances, the system needs Dependency Injection for its external clients.
acceptance_criteria: Refactor Provider classes and the `MultiSourceCorrelator` to accept HTTP clients and DSPy LM instances via their constructors.
Create mock clients/providers for the test suite.
Ensure local integration tests for the Dual-Write state machine can run entirely offline using injected mocks.
